summary: Committed test cleanup in the gizmo repo removing migrated Unity/Git UI assumptions and updating legacy extension docs. In the gizmo-registry repo, fixed a pnpm frozen-lockfile mismatch by pinning @lucide/svelte to the policy-overridden exact version, then successfully re-ran the registry update via the agent-server.
decisions: Pin @lucide/svelte in gizmo-registry to exact version 1.31.0 with --save-exact so it matches the lockfile override and frozen-lockfile install succeeds.
errors: registry.update via agent-server failed with ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE because @lucide/svelte was specified as ^1.31.0 in package.json while the lockfile pinned 1.31.0 (from an overrides policy).
